headline: Indian IT services showed mixed growth with AI driving outsized gains for a few firms while overall revenue expansion slowed.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI‑related revenue surged across the sector, notably 29% at Infosys and 47% at LTM. Margin guidance tightened for Infosys but improved for Coforge. Dividend payouts remained stable, with most firms maintaining or modestly raising payouts.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, boosting profit margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% outlook.

themes.title: Margin pressure vs improvement
themes.detail: Operating margins fell for Infosys and Wipro but rose for Coforge and HCLTech.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 13.6% YoY with strong AI‑led managed services deals.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut.
Revenue grew only 9.1% YoY and profit fell 1.9%.
